question: To whom must this teaching be given according to the condition of being endowed with all states and of having made a firm determination?
premises: A teaching is marked as something to be given.
The recipient is one endowed with all states.
The recipient is one who has made a firm determination.
inference: The teaching is to be given to one who is endowed with all states and has made a firm determination.
uncertainties: The referent of what is to be given is not named in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states and to one who has made a firm determination.
